items.title: 4.1 Tkinter se Graphical User Interface (GUI) banana (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.1 (PDF 49, printed 45), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: GUI development programs ko nazar aane wale hisson (visual elements), jaise windows, buttons, labels aur text boxes, ke zariye user se baat cheet karne deti hai (Figure 4.1). Command-line interface ke muqable mein GUI applications ko istemal karna aasan banati hai. Python GUI applications achhi tarah banane ke tools deta hai. Tkinter Python ki built-in library hai jis se GUI programs bante hain. Yeh saada hai, bohat istemal hoti hai, aur developers ko jaldi interactive applications banane deti hai.

blocks.alt: Simple GUI Example naam ki window, minimise, maximise aur close buttons ke saath. Andar oopar khaali text field, aik Button, lafz Label, aur kai lines wala bara text box hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.1: Graphical User Interface (GUI) (kitab ki Figure 4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: GUI programs ko windows, buttons, labels aur text boxes se user ke saath kaam karne deta hai.
Tkinter Python ki built-in GUI library hai: saada aur jaldi interactive applications banane wali.
